original_value: The research of incomplete fuzzy soft sets is of paramount importance in fuzzy soft sets, where the combination of incomplete fuzzy soft set and decision-making problem is of great significance. Incomplete information in fuzzy soft sets leads to more uncertainty and ambiguity in decision-making. The focus of this paper to propose an algorithm of fuzzy soft set based decision-making problems under incomplete information. On the basis of the weighted function, we introduce the notions of weighted incomplete soft sets and weighted incomplete fuzzy soft sets, and show an approach to weighted incomplete fuzzy soft sets for dealing with decision-making. Considering the missing weight function, the concept of incomplete weighted fuzzy soft sets is presented. Meanwhile, we apply the incomplete weighted fuzzy soft sets to solve the decision-making problem. As modal-style operators for fuzzy soft sets have a precise description of attributes possessed by objects, we apply modal-style operator for incomplete fuzzy soft set to deal with decision-making and propose a new algorithm to make it more accurate and simple.

result.paraphrase: Research on incomplete fuzzy soft sets is highly important within fuzzy soft sets, especially because combining incomplete fuzzy soft sets with decision-making is significant. Incomplete information in fuzzy soft sets introduces greater uncertainty and ambiguity into decision-making. This paper aims to propose an algorithm for fuzzy soft set-based decision-making problems under incomplete information. Based on a weighted function, we define weighted incomplete soft sets and weighted incomplete fuzzy soft sets, and present an approach using weighted incomplete fuzzy soft sets to handle decision-making. To address missing weight functions, the notion of incomplete weighted fuzzy soft sets is introduced. At the same time, incomplete weighted fuzzy soft sets are applied to solve decision-making problems. Since modal-style operators for fuzzy soft sets provide a precise description of the attributes objects possess, we use a modal-style operator for incomplete fuzzy soft sets to handle decision-making and propose a new algorithm to improve accuracy and simplicity.
